iterations.workflow: module-action/RunOnePhase phase selection -> ExecutePhases -> executed phases, compiled code, custom-hook effect and command status
installed modules constrain dependency/version choice (deps.installed): BuildDependencyGraph choice and LoadModuleReference refusal -> installed version/status

sync [-delete] on developer-mode modules: file change/delete detection -> reverse index routing -> namespace item deletion, module.xml change, whole-namespace order -> namespace items, compiled values, sync summary
list-dependents <module> [version] [-r repos]: dependency graphs -> dependents tree -> printed report
filesystem repository version index and match query (SemanticVersion.Index/Find via Repo/Filesystem/Cache OrderedMatches) -> offer order and match set -> install/search choice
list-installed [flags] -> installed module rows (namespace) -> flat list / tree / sort -> printed report
module <InstallerClass>: load/uninstall -> Activate/Configure and Unconfigure phases -> installer callbacks with arguments and variables -> command status and installed state
Copy resource processor: resource copied from a Source namespace into the installing namespace during Reload, Overwrite flag -> target items after load

history find / details [-phases] rendering: stored %IPM_General.History rows -> VersionToString, TimeToString, SourceToString, SuccessToString, CommittedToString, ShowPhases, DisplayOneRecord/ShowColumns, DisplayQueryResult -> printed report
editing an installed module manifest as the <name>.ZPM document (document API used by IDEs): save/compile -> stored module record and readers; invalid edit; document delete
UnitTest resource processor: test-class load before the test phase and removal after it, by developer mode and declared Phase -> test classes present in the namespace, tests run, command status
config set/get/delete/list over UniversalSettings keys and their readers (getters used by consumers)
preload code: Initialize phase loads/compiles the module preload directory -> preload classes available; -only phase selection decides whether preload is refreshed
namespace source-control extension -> IPM lifecycle/document hooks (%OnBeforePhase/%OnAfterPhase/%OnModifyResources/%OnChangeModuleRoot) -> calls received and phase outcome
arrange <module>: ExportDocumentForObject rewrites the module manifest (stored .ZPM document and module.xml on disk) in standard order; XMLCommentHandler carries existing XML comments over
sync file discovery: scan directory collection/dedup, directory walk and hashing, path normalization and path->document name mapping -> which edits sync detects and which documents it touches
show <module>: stored manifest -> ModuleSummary sections (fields, resources by section, dependencies, system requirements, requirements.txt, dependents) -> printed text
test result report formats: test -only -f json|yaml|toon (device summary) and -output-file .json/.yaml/.toon/.xml (exported file) -> same facts in each format
CPF resource: merge a CPF file into the instance configuration at a declared phase (Before/After) or custom phase -> instance setting, command status
import <file|dir> [-norecurse] [-nocompile]: files -> classes loaded/compiled in namespace -> command status/output
default-modifiers -set/-get/-delete -> stored namespace defaults -> merged into later commands (data -D and flag modifiers) -> consumer outcome
`information` (info) lists installed top-level modules: installed modules minus every module named as a dependency; external names and versions without build

module record persistence on load of a changed manifest: save hooks (%OnAddToSaveSet, %OnBeforeSave, %OnOpen, %OnNew), relationship comparison, lifecycle class resolution -> stored record and namespace code
generate -t <dir> (template) and generate <dir> -export <spec> (export namespace items) -> written module.xml and exported files
help [<command>] rendering from the Commands XDATA and the version command
zn/namespace listing and switching, exec/cos, init non-interactive decisions

localization resources: .LOC message document (Default.LocalizedMessages, Directory localize) loaded into the message dictionary; LocalizationExport resource exporting domains to a file after compile; reload overwrite; uninstall removal

deprecated CSPApplication resource processor: load (non-dev, dev), reload, uninstall of a module declaring a CSP application with a static-file source directory -> Security.Applications entry, files in the deployment directory, pre-existing application handling
DeepSeeItem (.DFI) resources: load (non-dev, -dev), reload with changed/removed item, uninstall -> DFI documents in namespace, content, status

automatic resource mappings: Reload calls each resource processor OnConfigureMappings (unless NoMapping) -> namespace package/routine/global mappings -> which database the code resolves from; uninstall

legacy localized messages: <Resource ProcessorClass="LegacyLocalizedMessages" includeFiles=... merge=...> message XML -> ^IRIS.Msg/^IRIS.MsgNames domains and a generated include file of macros -> reload, merge, uninstall
WebApplication resource processor: declared attributes (incl. expressions) -> web application properties on install/reload; name normalization; phase timing; uninstall

Interoperability resources (.LUT lookup tables, .HL7 custom schemas) in an interoperability-enabled namespace: load (default and explicit Directory), reload of an edited table, uninstall -> lookup entries/schema documents present, command status

uninstall cleanup across ordinary resource kinds (CLS, PKG, INC, MAC/INT, GBL name-only and Global attribute, FileCopy file/folder with/without KeepOnUninstall, declared <Mapping>), non-dev and dev: what remains after uninstall

failed ordinary load (normal mode in a transaction, and developer mode) with side-effecting resources: FileCopy, WebApplication, declared <Mapping>, .LOC messages and export, CPF merge, dev ^Sources -> what survives the failure vs a successful load
developer-mode versus normal-mode refresh across resource kinds (CLS/PKG, INC, MAC, GBL, FileCopy, WebApplication, LOC, DFI) on load again, module reload+compile, and sync -> namespace content
<module> document: %Document phase -> dependency recursion -> generated API documentation artefacts, status, history

editor-facing callbacks of IPM composite source control (%IPM.ExtensionBase.Composite): which configured extension (primary vs others) receives OnBeforeSave/OnAfterSave/OnBeforeLoad/OnAfterCompile/OnBeforeDelete/GetStatus/IsReadOnly/UserAction/ItemIconState for module and non-module items, and how results combine
